items.title: Why I tried to kill token billing (and why we kept it)
items.excerpt: Token billing is useful infrastructure, but usually a bad customer-facing pricing model. Your invoice should define the value your product delivers, not break down what it cost you to create it.

items.title: OUSD is now the default stablecoin on Stripe
items.excerpt: Open USD (OUSD), a stablecoin built for global money movement, is now available across Stripe. Businesses can use OUSD to manage funds, make payments, and offer new financial services.

items.title: Helping personal agents shop more intelligently and reliably with Link
items.excerpt: As agents take on more purchases, agent builders have increasingly asked us to help agents navigate checkout and earn consumer trust. Today, we’re sharing three major improvements to support this broader set of needs.

items.title: Travel’s AI dilemma at Skift Global Forum
items.excerpt: At the “great recalibration”-themed travel conference, Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky called AI “an existential risk” to his company and “literally the best thing to ever happen” to it in the same discussion. That sums up many travel leaders’ push-and-pull relationship with AI.

items.title: New trends in global card fraud: How 3D Secure and regional mandates are affecting risk
items.excerpt: We analyzed billions of transactions on Stripe from January 2022 to March 2026 to understand how card fraud patterns differ by region and country, what's driving those differences, and how businesses can respond.

items.title: Analyzing rising fraud attempts among travel and leisure businesses on Stripe
items.excerpt: Last year, Stripe data shows fraud attempts against travel and leisure businesses hit a four-year high. We analyzed payment activity from more than 200,000 active travel and leisure businesses on Stripe to understand where fraud is rising, how effectively it’s being blocked, and what businesses can do in response.

items.title: SaaS platforms are surging despite the SaaSpocalypse
items.excerpt: The SaaSpocalypse was a useful warning for the software industry, but SaaS platforms that help businesses run core operations are more deeply embedded. New platform businesses on Stripe are up 182% year over year.

items.title: What Stripe data shows about fraud at AI startups
items.excerpt: We analyzed attempted fraud rates and customer abuse patterns on Stripe over the past year and found that AI companies faced 4.3x more fraud attempts than startups overall in Q3 2025.

items.title: Five monetization trends from global pricing leaders
items.excerpt: As AI transforms software economics, the standard revenue playbook is breaking down. Learn how leaders around the world are preparing for agent buyers, updating processes for faster pricing iteration, and building more flexible infrastructure.

items.title: Why global workers are driving demand for stablecoin payouts
items.excerpt: Platforms like DoorDash, Meta, and Deel already enable stablecoin payouts for global workers. We surveyed 2,300 workers in 20 countries to see what's driving stablecoin demand, where the opportunity is highest, and how other platforms can adapt.
